name: Tōno (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Tōno city emblem in white: a stylised letter e with a pointed upper stroke.
history: Municipal flag of Tōno, a city in Iwate Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 June 2006.

features.role: Tōno city emblem — a stylised letter e with a pointed upper stroke
